_comment: Project archetypes. A profile is a name a project claims and rules opt into via their frontmatter. This registry exists so a typo in either place is caught rather than silently dropping a rule. A profile with no rules of its own is legitimate: it just means the universal and detected rules are enough.

profiles.static-site: Hand-written HTML and CSS, no framework, no build step. The publish boundary matters and the design system applies.
profiles.python-service: Python app or scheduled job, Supabase behind it, deployed on Render. A push to main is a deploy.
profiles.tooling: The toolkit itself. Rules, hooks, catalogs, and the private job-search material.
